title: Keep empty reservation accounting changes unpromoted
question: Does removing empty grants and zero-byte ledger releases meet the frozen whole-Run benefit rule?
summary: Restore production: elapsed benefit misses the practical threshold and one CPU pair regresses; retain the unchanged patch as unpromoted evidence.

workloads: One million plain probe-v1 pipeline rows; four workers, 32-MiB job/shared limits, fixed seed and strict output caps.

validation.summary: Six jobs preserve fields, IDs, groups, caps, CSV/Analysis parity and cleanup. Recorded measured-head local workflows cover Linux/Windows and browser/WASI; final production sources are restored before delivery.

limitations: Two observations per primary variant, uncontrolled cache/background state, overlapping ranges and coarse CPU counters do not establish general gains.
The two accounting changes are not isolated; reservations are not an RSS cap.
exclusions: The ordered control and earlier timing/percentage gains are not pooled into the primary cell.
No retuning, extra shapes, repeated jobs or cleanup-label promotion follows from this result.
